title: Branch protection
description: The branch-protection record (monitor/private/branch-protection.json, CW_BRANCH_PROTECTION; public shape manifests/branch-protection.example.json). bin/verify-branch-protection.mjs asserts each repo's live required-status-checks are a superset of requiredChecks; bin/commit-provenance.mjs applies unsigned-on-protected-branch only where requireSigned is true.
